source.title: Shippingport Station Start-up Test DL-S-163 (T-554923), AECU-4028

scope: The released model reaches high primary coolant temperature and pressure much earlier than Shippingport did. The comparison uses the original generic startup schedule. Differences in design, initial conditions and station operating history limit what these errors establish about individual equations.
alignment: First timed entry of the station's event log (Table I, PDF page 6). The report starts its formal indicator logging at 14:02 on June 24. Civil clocks are transcribed without a time-zone offset. Both clocks retain all elapsed time, including the interruption. Predictions end at 7.5 hours.
limitations: The measured event includes an extended interruption for instrument repair and a later loss of one coolant loop. Its initial conditions, design and heatup schedule differ from the generic model.

The source does not report a continuous reactor power record. The selected event ends at turbine synchronism with the generator breaker still open. Grid loading and sustained full-power operation have no observed trajectory in this record.
The event log records temperatures at selected times. Some leg values refer to earlier extrema or an unspecified leg. Those entries are omitted from the 1A channel.

The report plots hot and cold leg temperatures together in Figure 1. Overlap and the chart's compressed time break limit separate digitization. This dataset uses directly tabulated and logged measurements.

Instrument calibration, measurement error bounds, local barometric pressure and the averaging method for bulk primary temperature are unspecified. Decimal conversion precision does not express instrument accuracy.

Unresolved digits are recorded by timestamp in unreadable. The source-flagged 19:20 reactor pressure retains its raw value and an explicit exclusion. Source dashes in the temperature row remain missing.

periodicLoggingGap.note: Table II has no intervening columns. Table I separately records a 09:30 observation on June 25.

sourcePages: One-based PDF scan page. Printed report page equals PDF page minus one.

milestone.label: Turbine synchronism
milestone.note: Shippingport reported turbine synchronism with the main generator breaker open. The native marker is the first retained open-breaker synchronization permissive. These describe different criteria. Historical grid-connection timing and electrical export are unobserved.

channels.label: Reactor pressure
channels.description: Table II reactor pressure and Table I entries that explicitly report reactor pressure in psig. Indicator identity across tables and local atmospheric pressure are unspecified. Gauge readings use one standard atmosphere for conversion.

points.excluded: The report flags a probable logging error. Its recorder chart could not substantiate this pressure (PDF p. 3).

channels.label: Average primary coolant temperature
channels.description: Table I explicitly reported average coolant temperature and Table II Avg. Coolant Temp. Loop weighting and averaging method are unspecified. The arithmetic mean of the model hot- and cold-leg temperatures is an observation proxy.

channels.label: Loop 1A cold-leg temperature
channels.description: Table I explicitly identifies Tc for loop 1A, sometimes with the same value for 1B. Only the 1A reading is counted. Log entries describing earlier extrema without exact observation times are omitted.

channels.label: Pressurizer temperature
channels.description: Table I observed pressurizer temperatures and Table II Pressurizer Temp. The 14:40 control objective is excluded. The report attributes pressurizer temperature to a recorder (PDF p. 3).
